thag4.7:1.1: Yo dandhakāle tarati taraṇīye ca dandhaye, ayonisosaṃvidhānena bālo dukkhaṃ nigacchati, || ||
thag4.7:2.1: tass' atthā parihāyanti kālapakkhe va candimā, āyasakyañ ca pappoti mittehi ca virujjhatīti. || ||
thag4.7:3.1: yo dandhakāle dandheti taraṇīye ca tāraye, yonisosaṃ vidhānena sukhaṃ pappoti paṇḍito, || ||
thag4.7:4.1: tass' atthā paripūranti sukkapakkhe va candimā, yaso kittiñ ca pappoti, mittehi na virujjhatīti. || || Sambhūto thero.
